title: RacketPal Rally Weekly Rally Duration Trend
dataSources: Bar-velocity reps (`vbt:rep`), running gait (`gait:metric`), hangboard sessions (`hangboard:session`), golf-swing metrics (`golfswing:metric`), power-meter intervals (`powermeter:interval`), basketball shot arcs (`shotarc:make`).
app: Sports and skill sensors — velocity-based-training bar trackers, running-form IMUs, climbing hangboard load cells, golf launch monitors, cycling power meters, and computer-vision shot trackers — logged to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=racketpal:rally duration_sec=*
| bin _time span=1w
| stats avg(duration_sec) as avg_duration, max(duration_sec) as worst_duration by _time
| sort _time
description: Trends the average and worst rally duration for RacketPal rally events each week.
value: Weekly timing trends show whether a process is becoming slower, more erratic, or healthier over time.
implementation: Capture duration_sec on each event and review weekly averages plus worst cases during your personal ops review.
visualization: Line chart of weekly average rally duration with markers for the worst week.
grandmaExplanation: It gently whether RacketPal rally tasks are taking longer than they used to and where the slow weeks were.
